title.narrative: DCAF: Enhanced Security Provision/Governance for Palestinians

description.narrative: Two phases: First, the project will involve Palestinian citizens, representatives, and members of all Palestinian political factions and selected stakeholders from the security sector in separate consultations focusing on Palestinian people's needs in terms of security provision. Second, the project intends to inform the international community and regional actors about the needs articulated by Palestinians, and then engage them in a reflection process that aims towards a) articulating concrete (interim) modalities for security provision and governance capable of strengthening safety and stability in the short term, and b) informing SSG/R programming in the mid and longer term.
